test.note: The test key is published on purpose. It proves the code path, not authenticity.

production.key_source: environment variable BRAINK_SIGNER_KEY or an external KMS/HSM reference
production.note: Raises NotImplementedError until real key infrastructure is wired in. Cannot be PRODUCTION_VALIDATED from this package.

rules: Never commit private keys, HMAC secrets or KMS credentials to this repository.
Production key material must be supplied at runtime via environment or a secrets manager.
A signer whose key cannot be independently attested must not claim a status above DEFINED.
